stemMd: A book’s pages are numbered from 1 to 120. How many page numbers contain the digit 0?
explanationMd: From 1 to 99, the qualifying numbers are 10,20,…,90, nine numbers. From 100 to 109, all ten qualify; 110 and 120 also qualify. Total 9 + 10 + 2 = 21. Count numbers, not occurrences of the digit.

distractorRationale.a: This counts only multiples of ten and misses 101 through 109.
distractorRationale.b: This omits one of the qualifying numbers at a boundary.
distractorRationale.d: This double-counts a number such as 100.
distractorRationale.e: This includes numbers that do not contain zero.
